'''Max Llovera González-Adrio''' (born 8 January 1997) is an Andorran professional [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)#Centre-back|central defender]] for Spanish club [[CP San Cristóbal]].<ref>{{LaPreferente|210557<!-- /max-llovera -->|accessdate=18 May 2017}}</ref>

==Career==
===FC Santboià===
On 20 December 2018 [[FC Santboià]] confirmed, that Llovera had signed for the club.<ref>[http://fcsantboia.cat/landorra-max-llovera-nou-jugador-del-santboia/ L’Andorrà Max Llovera, nou jugador del Santboià], fcsantboia.cat, 20 December 2018</ref>

===International career===

Llovera debuted for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 3 September 2015.
